stance_rationale: Primary V2 relies on an observed-sign reversal of F1 while rank_IC and DSR fail explicit Alpha Gate thresholds. The package also does not persist the primary V2 time-series score cleanly: alpha_scores.parquet contains V1 alpha, while the V2 alpha_vector in JSON is an unkeyed numeric array.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: Multi-date panel exists, but the persisted alpha column is V1; primary V2 is only recoverable by recomputing -F1+F2+F3 or reading v2_diagnostics.rds. The package alpha_vector is unkeyed, so downstream ticker mapping is unsafe.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: V2 explicitly multiplies the FIAP composite by -1 after V1 produced t=-4.23; this is a manual sign flip even if framed as composite-level reinterpretation.
run_alpha.R uses load_month_factors(sig_date); Usable_Date evidence is not persisted in alpha_scores.parquet, so this remains code-path based.
run_alpha.R sources factor_db_connector.R and calls load_month_factors(); no direct Factor DB parquet load was found in the alpha computation path.
sig_date month-end factors are applied to next-month Ret_1m; no same-day overlay was found.
AC22 lag is delegated to Factor DB annual-May/quarterly-45d logic; artifact-level filing dates are not included.

critical_concerns.description: V2 is the exact post-hoc sign reversal of the failed V1 F1 signal; DSR_post=0 and the package itself counts six tried variants. This is method-shopping risk, not a clean KR herding-reversal discovery.

Primary V2 is not the persisted alpha_scores.parquet alpha column. alpha_scores.parquet alpha ranks V1 names, while V2 top names are only recoverable from v2_diagnostics.rds or an implicit recomputation; alpha_vector also lost ticker names in JSON.
Graduation gates fail on rank_IC 0.029252 < 0.04, DSR 0 < 0.50, and monotonicity 0.6727 < 0.80. PASS_BORDERLINE should not override explicit Alpha Lab gates.

Composite value-add is weak: V2_ALL ICIR 0.275 is below V2_F1flip_F2 ICIR 0.312, so adding F3 reduces ICIR. Recent 2021-2023 ICIR is about 0.719, over 2.6x full ICIR, triggering recent-regime overfit risk.
Liquidity and turnover are not mandate-clean: the alpha build uses a 5e7 KRW floor, below the base 2e8 KRW hard floor, and turnover proxy is 7.7146/year versus the 6.0/year hard cap.

No standalone challenge_note.md or artifact_lineage.json was found, and requested weights.csv/covariance.parquet/other-agent packages were absent. AX-008 triangulation is therefore not satisfied from available artifacts.

Academic mechanism support is under-specified: references lack page-level citations, Kim-Kim monthly-horizon applicability is unverified, and F2/F3 are weak univariate contributors imported from broader literature.
AX-007 is deferred to optimizer, but the handoff remains a single alpha vector intended for long-only top-name construction without proving one of the four AX-007 exceptions.

supporting_arguments: Raw time-series coverage is not a single-date panel: 240 monthly sig_dates from 2003-12-30 to 2023-11-30, no future dates.
V2 ICIR 0.275, Harvey t 3.867, and positive subperiod rate pass if the sign flip is accepted.
Parent inheritance correlation is low at about 0.0706, and AX-003/AX-005 direct value/defense failure patterns are not used.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Kim-Kim (2014) supports one-month KR foreign/institutional herding mean-reversion specifically, not only a shorter-horizon herding result.
Sector-neutral ICIR impact, top-decile liquidity at 2e8 KRW, and PG2 active-strategy correlation <0.5 were not independently evidenced.
v2_diagnostics.rds provenance is not reproducible from a visible generation script in the reviewed files.
Requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260428_001, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, and other 3-agent packages were not present, so schedule/PSD/condition audits could not be completed.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that the observed V1 negative F1 result can be converted into an ex-ante V2 herding-reversal mechanism rather than being a prohibited sign-flip selected after seeing performance.
rebuttal_required: Provide a reproducible script that creates v2_diagnostics.rds and writes primary V2 score into alpha_scores.parquet with Date x Ticker x score_v2.
Serialize alpha_vector and confidence_vector as ticker-keyed objects, not positional numeric arrays.
Re-run the alpha panel using the 2e8 KRW liquidity floor and report top-decile TV plus turnover after 15bps costs.
Show RF-A2/RF-A3 diagnostics: V2_ALL vs V2_F1flip_F2 ICIR and rolling/recent 3Y ICIR ratios.
Provide page-level references and horizon-specific KR evidence for the herding-reversal mechanism before using the sign flip.
rationalization_red_flags: not a manual factor-level direction override

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Claude's self-check already flags rank_IC and DSR failure, but understates the artifact integrity problem: the primary V2 score is not the persisted alpha column and the JSON alpha_vector has no ticker identifiers.

alpha_specific_questions: 이 factor가 KR market에서 t_NW > 2.95를 fund-of-fund 환경에서 유지할 수 있는가?
alpha vector 시계열에 future leakage 없는가? 특히 fundamental t-lag와 V2 post-hoc sign flip을 분리 검증했는가?
AX-axiom EXCLUSION에 의존하는 가설이라면 EXCLUSION 충족이 necessary AND sufficient한가?
